thread:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout rl-20260320-01 for /generate (v2) — 5% traffic in us-west. monitor: canary-metrics, rollout-doc: https://confluence/redwood/rollouts

maria-g: quick question — is v2 additive? specifically will `stop_sequences` or truncation semantics change for unversioned clients?

liam: v2 is intended to be backwards-compatible but we did change the default truncation to head-based. we kept the old behavior behind `truncate_mode=tail` and a version header. to opt in use header `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2`. tokenization unchanged.

sophie: we should post a short release note + changelog + SDK note. also schedule a 1hr change window today. @kevin can you reach out to top 5 customers to offer pinned v1? :eyes: 

kevin: can do. plan: keep unversioned default as v1 for 72h, opt-in header for v2. if any customer needs immediate stability, i'll pin their traffic to v1 via admin API. example pin command: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/routes/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"route":"/generate","version":"v1","until":"2026-03-23T00:00:00Z"}'`

maria-g: i'll open a mobile SDK PR to set header for new clients and add a migration guide.

deploy-bot: Canary update (10m): latency p95 +12ms, error_rate 0.7% (baseline 0.2%), avg token cost +0.03. samples pushed to /canary-samples.

liam: 0.7% error bump is non-trivial. can we get a breakdown? 5xx vs client-side decode failures?

ops-bot: Canary trace link: https://perf.redwood/canaries/rl-20260320-01/traces (perm: engs)

sophie: suggestion: throttle canary to 2% while we triage, and grab more logs. can we pause new rollouts?

kevin: after looking at samples, several failures are tokenization edge-cases for newline-heavy prompts. i'm leaning to pause and pin route to v1 until patch. unless someone objects i'll execute rollback.

maria-g: +1 pause. no customer impact if we pin to v1. please include rollback note in the changelog.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback: rl-20260320-01 -> pin v1 applied. rollback_ts=1750357040. Canary traffic removed, all routes back to v1.

liam: I'll investigate tokenizer config mismatch with the model artifact. hypothesis: tokenizer trim behavior differs between model builds. will aim for a patch and small canary after fix.

kevin: I've notified top customers and pinned any that requested it. I'll follow up with migration timelines.

maria-g: thanks team. open follow-up: include error samples, stack traces, and a short postmortem if we hit >1% errors next rollout.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0319 and linked to this thread. archiving to incidents channel.

sophie: postmortem note: keep default behavior pinned for 72h for safety, communicate clear header opt-in path. we'll schedule a short retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
